artboards.title: How a tag becomes a tile on the map

annotations.text:
DECIDED 2026-09-14: the Terrains section works like Tiled's terrain editor — pick a terrain, tag corners on the sheet image, coloured overlays, list beside the image.

The modal grows to the window for this section only; the rail stays so it is still Project settings.

The block and the cells are real pixels from an MZ Outside_A2 sheet as scripts/import-mz.mjs converts it, with the tags its sidecar carries. The images are local references and are not committed.

The dual grid in one picture: tiles live on corners, quadrants on cells.
DECIDED 2026-09-17: tagging is undoable, with the editor's own history while it is open. The other settings stay non-undoable.
